status_events.label: Verified fact

what_it_does.v: Defines how MCP clients obtain and present access tokens to protected MCP servers: MCP server is an OAuth 2.1 resource server; MUST publish Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728); clients MUST use PKCE and Resource Indicators (RFC 8707) so tokens are audience-bound; servers MUST reject tokens not issued for them (token passthrough forbidden). The Enterprise-Managed Authorization extension lets the corporate IdP decide which MCP servers an employee can use via an Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant.
what_it_does.label: Verified fact

stage_a_notes: Latest MCP specification revision is 2026-07-28 (docs nav marks it 'latest'). Material changes: stateless protocol (no initialize handshake, no Mcp-Session-Id); RFC 9207 'iss' validation; issuer-bound client credentials; Dynamic Client Registration deprecated in favour of Client ID Metadata Documents; Roots, Sampling and Logging deprecated. Authorisation remains OPTIONAL for MCP implementations. OAuth 2.1 itself is still an IETF draft (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13 cited). AWS AgentCore Gateway and Kong AI Gateway 2.1.0 already list support for 2026-07-28.
